rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something without stopping.

example.english: They talked ceaselessly until I got a headache.
example.traditional: 佢不停咁講，搞到我頭都大埋。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bat1 ting4 gam3 gong2 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 tau4 dou1 daai2 maai4

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing an ongoing or repeatedly continuing action.

example.english: Lately, it has been raining ceaselessly, and the road keeps flooding.
example.traditional: 呢排啲雨不斷咁落，條路成日水浸。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 di1 jyu5 bat1 dyun6 gam3 lok6 tiu4 lou6 sing4 jat6 seoi2 zam3

rows.note: Use this when the action continues throughout a particular stretch of time or activity.

example.english: We chatted ceaselessly all the way to the waterfront.
example.traditional: 我哋一路傾偈一路行到海旁。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 lou6 king1 gai2 jat1 lou6 haang4 dou3 hoi2 pong4
